baselineName: CI-P2A canonical regression reuse — first verified duplicate removal
policy: CI-P0 observed baseline is immutable. CI-P1 bounded shadow remains opt-in. CI-P2A removes the redundant Merge Execution Guard restore/build/full-test pipeline; that guard must consume a completed successful canonical Build ARSAS proof for identical PR merge source and engine SHAs, otherwise fail closed. Subsequent reductions require equivalent explicit evidence.
interpretation: The limits freeze CI sprawl; they are not performance targets and do not prove semantic necessity.
CI-P1 is expected to reduce restore/build/test counts and introduce reusable workflow_call contracts. Any temporary migration increase must be explicit in the same reviewed change.
Release, physical evidence and IEC 61850 acceptance semantics remain owned by their existing contracts during CI-P0.

ciP1MigrationShadow.purpose: Two additive workflows: one advisory change classifier and one reusable exact-SHA Windows compile/test job for opt-in shadow parity. No legacy workflow retired or replaced.
ciP1MigrationShadow.exitGate: Only retire a legacy workflow or lower limits after shadow parity on matching source/engine SHAs, equivalent test verdicts, and explicit review of physical/release gate ownership. No release/promotion claim based on shadow results.

ciP2Consolidation.approach: Reuse completed canonical Build ARSAS exact-merge-SHA full-regression TRX artifact; no duplicate .NET compile for PR events. Keep original source-contract check and status name, read-only API, manual fallback via reusable full build/test.

candidateVerification.canonicalRun: successful latest matching PR head/branch run
candidateVerification.tests: signed-by-workflow-at-execution manifest plus verified TRX SHA-256 and passing counters

ciP2Consolidation.rollback: Restore original smart-discovery-merge-execution-guard.yml build/test steps if canonical evidence or cross-run matching causes flakiness; never skip P0-5h source-contract checks.
